description: Sparse deterministic explanatory notes for resolved underlying causes whose immediate fatal chain may not be obvious from public mortality tables. Notes never alter statistical rolls.

notes.text: Recorded as the underlying cause of death; the immediate fatal mechanism or intervening complication is not available in this dataset.
notes.provenance: Statistics Finland 11be tabulates the underlying cause of death at ICD-10 3-character level. The public table does not provide the complete medical-certificate sequence of immediate and antecedent causes for the individual death.
